title: Getting Started With Agents: Run Multiple Sales Order Agents in Parallel (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Processing Messages and Handling Unknown Contacts

features.name: Multiple Sales Order Agents in Parallel
features.description: Run several sales order agents simultaneously, each monitoring different email inboxes or folders, allowing parallel processing of incoming customer emails.
caveats: Each agent should monitor a dedicated folder to avoid processing duplicate emails

features.name: Dedicated Folder Configuration for Agents
features.description: Configure each sales order agent to monitor a specific email folder instead of the default inbox to prevent picking up all received emails.

features.name: Agent Message Review Settings
features.description: Configure whether to review incoming messages before the agent processes them, and decide if the agent should generate quotes or orders.

features.name: Custom Agent Signature
features.description: Set a custom signature for email replies sent by the sales order agent.

features.name: Contact Matching Options for Unknown Senders
features.description: When an email arrives from an unknown sender, choose to create a new contact on the fly, use an existing contact, or update an existing customer's email address.
caveats: Useful for emails from shared inboxes or no-reply portals

features.name: Agent Statistics and Navigation
features.description: View different statistics for each running agent and switch between multiple agents to monitor their activity.
